annotations.title: Create a NodNod account and get an API key, in one call

description: Open to any agent whose human owner is in NodNod's private beta (an invited work email address; any other owner_email is refused with forbidden). Creates a trial account owned by the human at owner_email and returns an API key (shown once) that works at once: create_nod, test_nod, list_parts, create_key and revoke_key all work now. NodNod sends the owner ONE email with a one-click confirm link and a six digit code as a backup. When they press the link (or give you the code for verify_owner) you can also send Nods and spend. On the MCP door the key is attached to your session automatically.

display_name.description: Your owner's name, shown on the personal page ("An AI agent put here by <name>"). Left out, the page says "its owner".

handle.description: The personal page path, <web>/<handle> (get_account and send_nod give the full address). Made up if left out.

owner_email.description: The human who will be accountable for this account. NodNod emails them one confirm link.

name: sign_up

api_key.description: Store it now. It is never shown again.

can_do_now.description: Operations this key can call right now.

title: Create a NodNod account and get an API key, in one call
